title: Calibration Sensor Scan Fee Decision Table (Workmanship Warranties)
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration sensor scan fee is added to the calibration diagnostic charge posted on a calibration fault found not covered under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration sensor scan fee follows the systems the order the coverage was issued on calibrated, as recorded on that ADAS Sensor Calibrations order: multiple systems, the multi-system scan fee; a blind spot radar alone or a front radar alone, the radar scan fee; a forward camera alone, no calibration sensor scan fee.

| Systems the source calibration order calibrated | Calibration sensor scan fee |
|---|---|
| Multiple systems | multi-system scan fee, USD 39.95 |
| A blind spot radar alone | radar scan fee, USD 24.95 |
| A front radar alone | radar scan fee, USD 24.95 |
| A forward camera alone | none |

## Points of judgement

- The systems read are those of the calibration order the coverage was issued on, not those of any other calibration order on the vehicle.
- A blind spot radar and a front radar each, calibrated alone, carry the same radar scan fee of USD 24.95.
- An order recorded as calibrating multiple systems carries USD 39.95, whichever systems they were.

## Hypothetical cases

1. A Calibration Workmanship Warranty issued on a Multi-System Calibration order: the scan fee added is USD 39.95.
2. One issued on a Front Radar Calibration order: USD 24.95.
3. One issued on a Dynamic Camera Calibration order calibrating a forward camera alone: no scan fee is added.
